**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Direction check:** The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation or best-terms undertaking on Ono. Targeted searches for "most favorable/favored nation", "no less favorable", "not less favorable", "at least as favorable", "best price", "match" and "right of first negotiation" returned nothing running from Ono to Array, and full reads of Art. VI (Payments), Art. VII (Payments; Books and Records) and Art. VIII (Certain Covenants) confirm the planner's "likely absent" hint.
- **Only comparable-terms language runs our way:** Section 9.2(b) (p0502) provides that Array cannot require Ono to order Materials directly from a Subcontractor unless that Subcontractor will supply Ono "on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array" — a benefit to us, expressly not to be flagged.
- **Result:** This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN burdening the Customer; Vendor-side MFN preserved). Noted for the record but not flagged: Section 8.2 places exclusivity/non-compete restrictions on Ono, which is a separate commercial term reviewed under its own rule, not an MFN.
